quote.summary: SHENZHEN TRANSSION HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a China-based company primarily engaged in the design, research, development, manufacturing, sales and brand operation of smart devices, with a core focus on mobile phones. The main products include mobile phones under the TECNO, itel and Infinix brands, comprising both feature phones and smartphones. The Company also provides mobile internet services; leveraging its proprietary mobile operating system, Transsion OS, and a suite of applications, it offers services such as app downloads, gaming, and content browsing. The Company offers Internet of things products—including laptops, tablets, smartwatches, smart audio devices and digital accessories, as well as energy storage products and light electric mobility devices. It primarily sells its products in emerging markets across Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and South America.
